# Finding Rest in God's Presence

## Scripture

"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light." - Matthew 11:28-30 (NIV)

## Reflection

Life can be overwhelming at times, filled with responsibilities and cares that weigh us down. It's in these moments that Jesus invites us to come to him, to lay our burdens at his feet and find rest in his presence. His yoke, though it may look heavy, is actually light and easy to bear. This is because it's not a burden of self-effort, but a partnership with the gentle and humble Savior who cares for us deeply. When we take his yoke upon us, we learn to live a life of dependence on him, trusting in his strength and guidance to carry us through even the toughest times. As we do, we find rest for our souls, a peace that surpasses all understanding and fills our hearts with joy.

## Prayer

We come to you, Lord, weary and burdened. We lay our cares and concerns at your feet, trusting in your promise to give us rest. Give us the strength to take your yoke upon us, to learn from your gentle and humble heart.

## One-Line Application

We must learn to lay our burdens at the feet of Jesus.
